title: Separate theft drains, residual sweeps, internal exchange consolidation and chain-specific issuer freezes

decisions.rule: Classify theft drain, residual sweep, internal consolidation, recovery transfer, issuer freeze and ordinary customer flow separately. Never combine a successful transfer to an old exchange reserve wallet with a transfer to an attacker receiver.
Provider labels and account clustering support wallet attribution but do not prove legal ownership or the identity of the operator signing a transaction.
Track freeze actions by chain and token issuer. An Ethereum ERC-20 freeze is not evidence of an XRPL-issued token freeze. Native XRP cannot be issuer-frozen.
Every stolen-asset balance observation must include a precise cutoff; absence of observed movement is not proof of no later movement.

feature_admission: NONE. Incident flows are event-study/context data only until synchronized venue liquidity and execution effects are measured.
